notes: The whole app now agrees on what a 'gainer' is. The Market today card and the radar tiles were counting the same shares with two slightly different rules — the card treats a move within ±0.1% as flat (a hair's-breadth tick is not a real gain), while the tiles counted any move above zero — so the two screens showed different gainer and loser counts from the same data. One rule now answers everywhere: up means more than +0.1%, down means below −0.1%, and anything between is flat. The radar's Gainers/Losers filters follow the same rule.
